step_by_step_procedure: Group every 5th tally with a diagonal slash ('||||/').
Sum tallies to determine category frequency.
formulas_and_identities: Frequency = Count of observations in a category

step_by_step_procedure: Set category axis (horizontal) and frequency scale axis (vertical starting at 0).
Draw bars of uniform width separated by equal gap distances.
Calculate bar height = Frequency / Scale Value.
formulas_and_identities: Bar Height (cm) = Frequency / Scale per cm
sub_branches.example_problem: Frequency = 400, Scale: 1 cm = 100 units. Answer: Height = 4 cm.
